input._script:
if !haskey(ENV, "WRITER_GMSH_RELAUNCHED")
    ARTLIB = "/scratch/coop/drozda/.julia/artifacts/e23de324d2e0f44abb31f04148742ea251ee26f8/lib"
    new_env = copy(ENV)
    new_env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = ARTLIB * ":" * ARTLIB * "/pmix:" * ARTLIB * "/openmpi:" * get(ENV, "LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "")
    new_env["WRITER_GMSH_RELAUNCHED"] = "1"
    julia_bin = joinpath(Sys.BINDIR, "julia")
    cmd = setenv(`$julia_bin $(@__FILE__) $(ARGS)`, new_env)
    proc = run(pipeline(cmd, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr), wait=false)
    wait(proc)
    exit(proc.exitcode)
end

result = Dict{String,Any}()
node_info = Dict{String,Any}("hostname" => gethostname())
println(stderr, "NODE: ", node_info)
flush(stderr)

import Pkg
Pkg.activate("/scratch/coop/drozda/unstructured-mesh-writer")
Pkg.add(["HDF5", "YAML"])

try
    using Base64
    target = "/scratch/coop/drozda/unstructured-mesh-writer/writer_gmsh.jl"
    open(target, "w") do f
        write(f, String(base64decode("")))
    end

    yaml_path = tempname() * ".yaml"
    open(yaml_path, "w") do f
        write(f, "mesh_type: triangle\nbox_length: [1.0, 1.0]\nperiodic: [false, false]\ngmsh_options:\n  Mesh.CharacteristicLengthMax: 0.2\n")
    end

    include(target)
    main(yaml_path)

    h5_path = replace(yaml_path, r"\.ya?ml$" => ".h5")
    xdmf_path = replace(yaml_path, r"\.ya?ml$" => ".xdmf")

    n_vertices = n_cells = n_edges = 0
    h5open(h5_path, "r") do f
        n_vertices = attrs(f)["n_vertices"]
        n_cells = attrs(f)["n_cells"]
        n_edges = attrs(f)["n_edges"]
    end

    result["status"] = "ok"
    result["n_vertices"] = n_vertices
    result["n_cells"] = n_cells
    result["n_edges"] = n_edges
    result["h5_exists"] = isfile(h5_path)
    result["xdmf_exists"] = isfile(xdmf_path)
catch e
    result["status"] = "error"
    result["error"] = sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace())
end
result["hostname"] = node_info["hostname"]

esc(s) = replace(string(s), "\"" => "\\\"")
println("""{"hostname":"$(esc(result["hostname"]))","status":"$(esc(get(result,"status","unknown")))","n_vertices":$(get(result,"n_vertices","null")),"n_cells":$(get(result,"n_cells","null")),"n_edges":$(get(result,"n_edges","null")),"h5_exists":$(get(result,"h5_exists",false)),"xdmf_exists":$(get(result,"xdmf_exists",false)),"error":"$(esc(get(result,"error","")))"}""")
